name: linear
title: Linear
description: Small, editable Linear API ingestion example with raw ClickHouse tables.

resources.name: issues
resources.title: Issues
resources.description: Issue fields and the first 100 comments per issue.

setup: Provide LINEAR_API_KEY with read access to the selected resources.
Keep the API key in the runtime environment and rotate it according to the provider policy.

sync.description: A full read runs for each enabled stream. Stable IDs keep the latest observed record.
sync.schedule: Run bunx chkit ingest run --tag provider:linear from a scheduler.
sync.deletions: Every run reads all accessible issues. The example requests the first 100 comments per issue; extend the query for complete discussions.
